features: 【IP68 Waterproof Activity Tracker / Long Battery Life】Wear it without restraint,you can use it when you sweat,wash hands or get in the rain (Do not swimming, soak in hot water or sea water). A super minimalist,screen-free design,easy to operate. 180mAh battery,30 days standby,daily use for 5-10 days,you don't have to charge every day like a smart watch, it has a long battery life.

【CONTINUOUS MONITORING】No matter the heartbeat is irregular,it can remind you in time and check your physical condition. It can track your sleep status.With a full record of sleep,analyse the sleep quality,sleep duration,sleep depth. Let you understand your health better.

【Multiple Sports Modes Activity Trackers】Support multiple sports modes such as running,cycling,hiking,etc. It tracks your daily activity data such as steps,exercise time,calories,exercise heart rate tracking,mileage,record every second of the exercise.【Care for Family Members】By using the APP,you can add family members as friends.Click on the friends page to learn about your family's health information anytime and anywhere

【Fitness Smart Trackers】Lightweight to wear, 24/7 Automatically record your steps, calorie expenditure,and distance. Also provides exercise mode data so you can review specific workouts and quantify your progress over time.【Call/APP Reminder】After connecting the phone via Bluetooth,the wristband reminds you of Qwatchpro app messages by flashing indicator lights.
description: smart bracelets with screens, this tracker are more like invisible health assistants.It does not emit light interference during nighttime sleep, nor do they pop up notifications to distract attention during work or exercise. All data is synchronized and viewed through a mobile app,achieving simple daily health management. Perfect for fitness enthusiasts and seniors alike.
